method: Execute the repository static GLB auditor and official Khronos validator, load the saved editable source for axis-aware source/export comparison, and rebuild the generator/config in a separate bounded queue attempt. Compare semantic and byte digests of the emitted GLBs.
observations: Executed project audit and official Khronos validator report zero errors and warnings.
Actual editable source and exact GLB agree at 18,706 triangles and meter-space axis-converted bounds.
A fresh bounded separate-process rebuild is byte-identical and semantic-identical.
Three opaque materials/primitives; no textures. Authored source has 10,549 vertices; GLB has 14,590 POSITION-stream vertices.
Foliage has intentionally smooth normals and wood flat normals. Technical success does not establish visual/factual/specification/GPU or scene acceptance.
warnings: source: Conifer | clustered narrow needle-bearing shoots: smooth faces require intentional-style review
